description: This file defines a Config class used for managing configuration paths and data within the OpenCart system. It provides methods to add paths, load configuration files, and get/set configuration data.
external_files: (None explicitly referenced, but relies on PHP built-in functions and potentially other PHP files via require)

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class responsible for managing configuration data and paths in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace-to-directory mapping or sets the main directory if only a namespace is provided.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a configuration key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specific configuration key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a PHP configuration file, merges its returned array into the config data, considering path mappings.
